title: ECOS ontology entity-mappings frozen contract (F03-05)
description: Frozen response-shape contract for GET /api/v1/ontology/entity-mappings (REQ-ONTO-03, F03-05). Fields are additive-only: removing/renaming/changing any of the required entries listed here must fail the build (EntityMappingContractFrozenTest). The response is wrapped by ApiResponse { code: 0, data: [ ... this schema ... ] }.

entityCode.description: Owning ontology entity type code (e.g. Project, Customer, Contract).

datasetId.description: Backing dataset / data-resource identifier in the data-engine; null allowed for unmaterialised contracts.

resourceName.description: Physical / logical resource name as registered in the data-engine catalog (e.g. ecos_biz_stage_fact).

materialized.description: Q2_SKIP pipeline flag. null / "" / "true" / "1" => materialize (load); any other value => skip. Locked by KbMappingSkipTest.

fieldMappings.description: Column-level mapping entries; at least one entry is required for a materialised entity.

entityField.description: Logical field name on the ontology entity (camelCase dot-ok).

physicalColumn.description: Physical column name on the fact table (snake_case). Missing/renamed column vs. the frozen fact schema yields INVALID_MAPPING.

transform.description: Optional SQL transformation applied to the physical column during instance extraction (e.g. COALESCE(x, 0)); null = raw parity.
